CustomField.description: Developer name of the AdaptAbility queue (AdaptAbility_Accommodations/AdaptAbility_CustomerAccess/AdaptAbility_General/AdaptAbility_PrivacyLegal) that this escalation's reason code resolved to. The Case itself stays owned by the non-routed AdaptAbility_Case_Records holding queue (background record only); the live-chat outbound routing flow reads this field to decide which of the 4 real Omni-Channel queues to push the conversation to, so the chat lands in the same track/domain queue the Case's reason code implies without the Case itself being pushed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically by the AdaptAbility escalation action.
CustomField.label: Resolved Queue Name
